title: Checkout
description: A checkout card with press-and-hold to pay, live Sign → Relay → Settle progress, and a plain-language view of what is signed.

props.name: sessionId
props.description: Session created by your merchant backend.

props.name: amount
props.description: Displayed total in USDT base units. A changed quote is rejected.

props.name: label
props.description: Button text. Defaults to Pay with USDT.

props.name: onPaid
props.description: Updates your interface after inclusion. Fulfill from webhooks.

props.name: holdMs
props.description: How long to hold before confirming. Defaults to 900 ms.

props.name: className
props.description: Optional wrapper class for your site.

usage: <CustomCheckout sessionId={session.id} amount="10000000" label="Pay for my order" />

title: Payment status
description: A pixel track that follows a payment from sent to final, with a live timer and recoverable errors.

props.name: className
props.description: Optional wrapper class for your site.

title: Wallet button
description: A wallet pill with a pixel identicon and a menu to copy, switch network or disconnect.

props.name: className
props.description: Optional wrapper class for your site.

title: Product card
description: A product card whose add button turns into a quantity stepper, with pixel art when there is no photo.

props.name: product
props.description: A product returned by client.merchants.products or your PayKit catalogue.

props.name: className
props.description: Optional wrapper class for your site.

title: Receipt
description: A receipt that prints in, gets stamped, and lets customers copy the transaction reference.

props.name: paymentId
props.description: A payment identifier returned by checkout.

props.name: className
props.description: Optional wrapper class for your site.

title: Installment plan
description: An installment plan with an interactive payment schedule and press-and-hold confirmation.

props.name: input
props.description: Your existing invoice, session or server-priced cart.

props.name: total
props.description: Displayed total in USDT base units.

props.name: holdMs
props.description: How long to hold before confirming. Defaults to 900 ms.

props.name: className
props.description: Optional wrapper class for your site.

usage: <CustomInstallmentPlan input={{ invoiceId: invoice.id }} total="30000000" option={{ count: 3, periodSeconds: 2592000 }} />
